entities.name: Indra
entities.effect: Deal 3 damage to up to three targets; your creatures gain +1/+1 and Vigilance this turn.
entities.lore: King of the Devas, wielder of Vajra, breaker of Vritra.

entities.name: Agni
entities.effect: Sacrifice a permanent: Create two Treasure tokens and deal 2 damage to any target.
entities.lore: Two-faced god who carries offerings to the gods.

entities.name: Varuna
entities.effect: Tap up to three permanents. They don't untap during their next untap step. Draw 2 cards.
entities.lore: Keeper of Rta, binder of oaths and lord of cosmic waters.

entities.name: Vayu
entities.effect: Target creature gains +2/+0, Flying, and Haste until end of turn. Scry 2.
entities.lore: Pranic wind that animates all beings.

entities.name: Surya
entities.effect: Deal 4 damage to each enemy creature. You gain life equal to damage dealt.
entities.lore: Solar charioteer whose light reveals all.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.effect: Restore 4 life. Create a 1/1 Spirit with Flying for each 4 life you have above 20.
entities.lore: Lunar nectar that cools and heals.

entities.name: Yama
entities.effect: Exile up to two target creatures. Return a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
entities.lore: Lord of ancestors and righteous judgment.

entities.name: Kubera
entities.effect: Create four Treasure tokens. Draw a card.
entities.lore: Treasurer of the gods seated upon riches.

entities.name: Ganesha
entities.effect: Exile target artifact or enchantment. Scry 3, then draw a card. Your next spell costs 2 less.
entities.lore: Elephant-headed lord who clears paths and grants insight.

entities.name: Skanda (Kartikeya)
entities.effect: Create two 2/1 Warrior tokens with Haste. If you control Ganesha or Shiva, create two more.
entities.lore: Spear-wielding general of the gods.

entities.name: Hanuman
entities.effect: Target creature gains +3/+3 and Indestructible this turn. Untap it.
entities.lore: The mighty vanara, embodiment of bhakti and power.

entities.name: Parvati
entities.effect: Return up to two target creatures from your graveyard to your hand. Gain 4 life.
entities.lore: Consort of Shiva, gentle strength of the cosmos.

entities.name: Durga
entities.effect: Destroy target creature with power 4+. Your creatures gain +1/+1 and Trample this turn.
entities.lore: Ten-armed slayer of Mahishasura riding the lion.

entities.name: Kali
entities.effect: Destroy all nonlegendary creatures. For each destroyed, create a 1/1 Spirit under your control.
entities.lore: Black mother who devours time and frees souls.

entities.name: Krishna
entities.effect: Gain control of up to two target creatures until end of turn. Untap them; they gain Haste. Draw 2 cards.
entities.lore: Flute-bearing avatar who guides with joy and wisdom.

entities.name: Rama
entities.effect: Exile target tapped creature. Create a 2/2 Ally token (Hanuman synergy: that token gets +1/+1 and Haste).
entities.lore: Bowman-king, embodiment of dharma.

entities.name: Narasimha
entities.effect: Destroy target creature. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you this turn.
entities.lore: The man-lion avatar that tears through tyranny.

entities.name: Vamana
entities.effect: Search your library for up to two lands and put them onto the battlefield tapped. Scry 1, draw 1.
entities.lore: Dwarf avatar who spanned the universe in three steps.

entities.name: Parashurama
entities.effect: Destroy all artifacts and creatures with mana cost 3 or less.
entities.lore: The warrior sage who restored balance by culling excess.

entities.name: Matsya
entities.effect: Return up to three target cards from your graveyard to your hand.
entities.lore: Fish avatar who saves the seeds of civilization.

entities.name: Kurma
entities.effect: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to your permanents this turn. Create a Treasure token for each prevented this way.
entities.lore: Tortoise avatar that bore the churning of oceans.

entities.name: Varaha
entities.effect: Exile target graveyard. Return a permanent from your graveyard to the battlefield.
entities.lore: Boar avatar who raised the Earth from the abyss.

entities.name: Buddha
entities.effect: Counter target spell or ability. Its controller draws a card. You gain 3 life.
entities.lore: Avatar who ends suffering through insight.

entities.name: Kalki
entities.effect: Exile all nonland permanents with mana cost 4 or less. Create two 3/3 Avatar tokens with Haste.
entities.lore: Final avatar who resets the age.

entities.name: Dhanvantari
entities.effect: Restore all damage on your creatures. You gain 8 life. Create a Food token.
entities.lore: Physician of the gods bearing Amrita.

entities.name: Gayatri
entities.effect: Your next Invocation costs 3 less. Scry 3, then draw a card.
entities.lore: Meter and mother of Vedas, essence of sacred chant.

entities.name: Ushas
entities.effect: Untap up to three permanents. Draw a card.
entities.lore: Rose-fingered dawn that stirs the world.

entities.name: Ratri
entities.effect: Your permanents gain Hexproof until your next turn. Scry 1.
entities.lore: Protective night who cloaks with stars.

entities.name: Mitra
entities.effect: Target opponent becomes your ally until end of turn; both draw 2. Prevent all combat damage this turn.
entities.lore: Keeper of friendship and sacred contracts.

entities.name: Rudra
entities.effect: Deal 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If it dies, draw a card.
entities.lore: Howling storm that prefigures Shiva.

entities.name: Ashvins
entities.effect: Copy target spell you control. You may choose new targets. Restore 3 life.
entities.lore: Divine physicians who arrive at dawn.

entities.name: Soma
entities.effect: Draw 2 cards. Your maximum hand size is increased by 3 until end of turn.
entities.lore: Mystic nectar pressed under moonlight.

entities.name: Aditi
entities.effect: Create two 1/1 Deva tokens with Ward 2. Gain 4 life.
entities.lore: Boundless mother of the Adityas.
